description:
Join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This pivotal role combines staff development and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and a safe environment for both residents and staff. You will be instrumental in developing and delivering educational programs, as well as implementing and monitoring robust infection control protocols.

We are seeking a dedicated and proactive professional passionate about quality improvement and staff education. This position offers a unique opportunity to significantly impact patient outcomes and facility operations, fostering a culture of continuous learning and safety.
requirements: Experience in staff development or education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care
